heading: Regulations and guidelines; effect on other law

tree.heading: Promulgation of regulations and guidelines; report

children.heading: In general
children.text: The Secretary shall promulgate regulations and guidelines to implement this subchapter as expeditiously as practicable.

children.heading: Consultation with Attorney General
children.text: The Secretary shall consult with the Attorney General on the promulgation of regulations and guidelines under subparagraph (A).

children.heading: Report
children.text: The Secretary shall annually submit to the Committee on Agriculture of the House of Representatives and the Committee on Agriculture, Nutrition, and Forestry of the Senate a report containing updates on the implementation of this subchapter.

tree.heading: Authority
tree.text: Subject to subsection (c)(3)(B), the Secretary shall have sole authority to promulgate Federal regulations and guidelines that relate to the production of hemp, including Federal regulations and guidelines that relate to the implementation of sections 1639p and 1639q of this title.

tree.heading: Effect on other law
tree.text: Nothing in this subchapter shall affect or modify—

children.text: the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act (21 U.S.C. 301 et seq.);
the authority of the Commissioner of Food and Drugs and the Secretary of Health and Human Services—
the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act (21 U.S.C. 301 et seq.); or
to promulgate Federal regulations and guidelines that relate to the production of hemp under the Act described in subparagraph (A)(i) or the section described in subparagraph (A)(ii).

notes.heading: References in Text
notes.text: The Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act, referred to in subsec. (c)(1), (3)(A)(i), is act June 25, 1938, ch. 675, 52 Stat. 1040, which is classified generally to chapter 9 (§ 301 et seq.) of Title 21, Food and Drugs. For complete classification of this Act to the Code, see section 301 of Title 21 and Tables.
